comments.author: NeonLeviathan42
comments.content: This Tom & Jerry Run game is so much fun! I love the endless runner style, it's like Subway Surfers but with Tom and Jerry. Gotta collect those gold coins!

comments.author: SavageBlade_X
comments.content: Wow, Tom & Jerry Run is surprisingly addictive! The jumping mechanic is spot on and I'm always trying to beat my high score.  Totally worth a download, folks!

comments.author: Witcher4Lyfe
comments.content: OMG, this game is an endless runner with Tom and Jerry! I love that it's like Talking Tom Gold Run, but the characters make it 10x better. Gotta love it, right?

comments.author: xX_DarkAura_Xx
comments.content: This Tom & Jerry game is a blast. Collecting gold coins is the name of the game, just like the description says.  The subway city setting is pretty cool too. A must-play!

comments.author: StalkingKraken99
comments.content: It's like a fun mashup of other endless runners, so you already have a good idea, but Tom and Jerry Run? Sold! The coins are plentiful, and the game is smooth.

comments.author: NoobMaster9000
comments.content: Seriously, am I the only one who loves this Tom & Jerry Run game? Another endless runner! Definitely recommend checking it out if you are a fun of endless runner type of games!

comments.author: PhantomKatana_99
comments.content: The game is pretty funny. Reminds me of other games but is quite fun. Good job, it's a pretty good game. You should really try the game!

comments.author: CtrlAltDefeat
comments.content: This game is like those other runner games, only with Tom and Jerry. So, yeah, I quite like this game!

comments.author: LootGoblin89
comments.content: It's a fun endless runner! It's a simple game without any kind of unnecessary features. That's what make it fun. I really enjoyed play this game!

comments.author: xX_CosmicRevolver_Xx
comments.content: Tom & Jerry Run is a pretty good game! The mechanics are simple, but the gameplay is so fun! And the Tom & Jerry characters make it even better!
